name: Muqan Qaghan
contribution: The second son of Bumin Qaghan and the third khagan of the Göktürks and the First Turkic Khaganate.
legacy: He expanded the khaganate and secured its borders against the Hephthalites.

checks.lead: Muqan Qaghan (Old Turkic: 𐰢𐰆𐰴𐰣:𐰴𐰍𐰣, romanized: Muqan qaɣan, Chinese: 木杆可汗/木汗可汗; pinyin: Mùgān Kèhán/Mùhàn Kèhán; Sogdian: 𐼍𐼇𐼉𐼒𐼎 𐼉𐼒𐼄𐼒𐼎, romanized: mwx’n x’ɣ’n; Rouran: 𑀫𑀼𑀖𑀅𑀦 𑀕𑀅𑀖𑀅𑀦, romanized: Muɣan Qaɣan), personal name Ashina Yandu (阿史那燕都), was the second son of Illig Qaghan and the third qaghan of the First Turkic Khaganate. He expanded the khaganate and secured its borders against the Hephthalites.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
